text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear intro-body-conclusion structure with a direct thesis","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents its claim up front and develops it in a more clearly segmented argumentative structure."},{"evidence":"“there are many more advantages and possibilities” plus repeated pro-driverless claims","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay advances a fuller line of reasoning rather than mostly restating one side of the issue."},{"evidence":"“saving a lot of money… less stress with traffic jams” and later “use half the fuel… offer more flexibility than a bus”","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay incorporates multiple relevant details from the article to support its position."},{"evidence":"“people wonder who is at fault-the driver or the manufacturer?” followed by “these problems could be resolved”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges objections and responds to them instead of only asserting a position."},{"evidence":"“These cars could fundamentally change the world” and “extraordinary new way of transportation”","quality":"persuasive emphasis","description":"The essay uses stronger language to build conviction and make the position feel more compelling."}]}
